title: Spicy American Burger Buns
description: Soft, warm, yeasty buns to elevate your burgers, topped with a spicy kick from kimchi.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: use high-protein flour for better rise

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine warm water, yeast, and a pinch of sugar. Let it sit for 5-7 minutes until yeast is activated.
Add flour, salt, and chopped kimchi to the bowl. Mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Add beaten egg and melted butter to the dough. Mix until a sticky ball forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 10-12 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1-2 hours until doubled in size.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on desired bun size.
Shape each piece into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk.
Place the buns on the prepared baking sheet, leaving about 1 inch of space between each bun.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden brown.
Let the buns cool on a wire rack for 5-10 minutes before serving.
